panels.title: daily_flow 狀態 (最近 7 天，任一紅 → Critical)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "scheduler_run" and r._field == "ok")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: min, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: 每階段耗時 duration_ms (by step，告警 > 預期 2x)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "scheduler_run" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["step"])
